book.name: 1 Timothi
book.title: TIMOTHI Suh Pool Ih Takkhoh Raang Arah Le

content: Hanpiite dung nah pakna reeraang
Mihak teekaang ah lakanja theng, erah nang ih bah an wah likhiik ih thiik uno ese lam ih waantiit uh. Jaaro loong ah, anphoh anno et thiik uh,
wikuh loong ah an nuh et thiik uh, eno jaala loong ah anno annah et thiik rum uh, jaatrep esa tenthun lam ih ah.
Thaknuh neng luulu ih tongla loong echoomjoot etheng.

Enoothong thaknuh asuh hesuh hesah je abah, neng neng ih neng jaatang ah toom soksam rum ah eno nengnuh nengwah ih neng soksam rumta thaang ah toom ngaakthem rum ah. Neng rangsoom thooroom lam nah emamah jaatjaat ih reeraang rumjih, eno ba Rangte ah tenroon ang ah.
Thaknuh heh luulu, heh soksamte o uh lajeette ih bah, Rangte suh hanpi ano, rangwuung rangphe heh chosok raangtaan ih rangsoom ah ban soom ruh et ah.
Enoothong thaknuh ih heh hansi tenroon ni tongla abah amadi ething taat ang abah uh, etek cho ang ah.
Neng loong ah emoong lam nah latong raangtaan ih arah renbaat hala baat rum uh.
Enoothong o ih heh sano joonte, hedakdak ih heh jaatang loong ah lasoksamka bah heh tuungmaang ah edaan eha, eno erah mina ah lahanpiite loong nang ih ethithoon.
Marah thaknuh paang rook arok nang ih ehan lah angka bah thaknuh men nak wak raang an. Erah dam ih heh ah miwah suh jaasiit nook arah angtheng,

nyia heh reeraang pakna ah ese ang arah toom ang ah: hesuh hesah naririh ih soksamte minuh, wen anok heh nok ni noppoonte minuh, Kristo mina damdoh roong mootkaatte, chamchoh tokdoh mih chosokte, nyia ese mootkaat ni mote minuh toom ang ah.
Enoothong jaalah thaknuh men ah thaknuh le nah laraang theng; tumeah neng mihoh suh nook mok we chung abah, Kristo jiin nawa edok soon eah,
eno jaakhoni heh jeng kakhamta ah thetsiit ha, eno erah thetsiit ha ah moongla.

Erah dam ih noknok doh tumkhoom rum ano neng saapak ah liinsoon thuk rum ah; erah khodoh uh ethithoon reeraang ah, mih joobaat tiitwaan nyia noongrepwih ni neng sak ah lanaangthiin thang ih tum nyoot et rumha, neng lajengjih angta jeng ah nyoot et rumha.

Erah thoih jaalah thaknuh loong abah miwah suh ewe nook eah doh se ih liihang, neng sah ah dong pusom rum ano neng nok nengtap ah soksam lam ih toom tong rum ah, eno ba sengpi sengra ih seng ethih lam nah tajap thet baatri.
Tumeah mararah thaknuh loong ah Soitaan lalih ni ejen kaat ih rumta.

Enoothong, Kristo hanpiite minuh pan changka nah thaknuh mok je abah, erah thaknuh ah neng ih jaatjaat chosok theng, chaaste suh lathaam sootroot baattaan theng, chaaste ih bah neng luulu chamnaangte thaknuh loong ah toom chosok rum ah.
Chaas mihak phokhoh mootse mote loong ah ih neng toloop chola erah thanthan ejen boot choh eah, hedakdak ah Rangte tiit tumbaat suh nyia nyootsoot suh chekbekte loong raang ih ah.
Tumeah Rangteele ni raangha, “Maanpong ah chamnak tokdoh heh tui ah latangkhak theng” nyia “Mootkaatte suh neng toloop ah ekot ettheng.”
Chaas mihak tiit thetbaat arah wanyi tokhodoh ehan ih labaatka bah lachaat theng.
O rangdah mola erah nokwah dung nah kanja theng, wahoh loong nep toom cho asuh ah.

Rangte nyia Kristo Jisu erah dam ih esa rangsah loong ngathong ni Ngah ih arah jengkhaap loong ah kap an ih baat suh poon rumhala, tumjaat reeraang anbah uh o uh ladande theng nyia lachiik haatmui theng eah.
Teesu mootkaat nah mothuk suh mih khoh nah lak ih taajoh ano rangsoom kot suh lathuuhu theng. Rangdah mote damdoh laroong rooptheng; anteewah ah esa et thiintheng.
An khoisat nyia woksat dongsat lu adoh juung lalak nak jok uh, potiik kham amasah ah jok uno an khoisat ah deethuk uh.
Mararah mina rangdah ah rangkhoh ni kaptup ha; eno erah rangdah rah ih neng ah dande rum ah; enoothong rukhookho rangdah abah lini chotup ha.
Emamah ese mootkaat ah uh laantup ruh eha, eno mik ih latupka loong ah uh tajen huthiinka.
